title: Gouraigou
text: “Father.”
“Hm? Motoyasu, is that you? Taking a bath too?”
“Indeed I am!”
“Don’t go peeping.”
“HAHAHA, Father, that’s simply an impossible request. I must do it for the sake of the Filolial-samas, after all.”
“Sigh…”
Since the Filolial-samas were bathing, I fully intended to peep!
“The trouble is I have to pass through walls to manage it, Father. You really ought to set up a proper fence, I say.”

This bathhouse’s one shortcoming was that its structure made peeping rather difficult. Incidentally, the hot water was heated by whoever among us could use fire magic, all under the guise of “magic practice.” I myself sometimes took a turn as the water-heater.
“If you’ve got complaints, go use the hot springs on Cal Mira Island.”
“Either way, I’m getting in.”
“Yeah, yeah. Sadeena and Raphtalia are in there too, so keep it in moderation.”

Hmm… peeping on those two in particular was quite a formidable challenge. Big Sister always noticed me hiding to peep, and Older Sister could sense me passing through walls. Being noticed while peeping wasn’t a problem in itself, but if my peeping got stopped, I wouldn’t be able to properly appreciate the Filolial-samas’ charms. Depending on the situation, it might be better to wait until Big Sister and the others finished bathing.
“Come oooon, hurry up and get in—”
“Hurry, hurry—”
“Let’s float around—”
“Coming right now! Well then, Father, until later!”
“Yeah, yeah. Off you go, quickly now.”

Since the Filolial-samas were requesting that I hurry up and join them, I cut my greeting to Father short, slipped through the changing room, and headed in to bathe. To peep properly, I’d need to watch for my chance.
“With these flames of purgatory, I shall temper my very being. Thus shall the power of darkness seep into me… fufufu…”
Black Thunder was already soaking in the bath, first in line, so to speak.
“Hey, that tickles—”
“Yay, yay, wash me—”
“Midori said she’d come later, I wonder if she’s here yet—”
As I was having a delightful time washing each other with the Filolial-samas…
“Oh? I heard such lively voices and figured it might be Motoyasu-kun and the others in here,” Ark said, stepping into the bathhouse and waving at us.
“Hm…”
With Ark’s arrival, Black Thunder immediately abandoned that delightfully dramatic monologue of his.
“What’s wrong? Maybe you should work on that whole setting a bit more?”
“D-Don’t call it a ‘setting’! I am enduring the flames of purgatory here, awaiting the coming of the Dark Holy Hero!”

“Flames of purgatory… I mean, if you asked that bird, she’d probably whip some up for you, but I think you’d need to level up quite a bit more with Motoyasu-kun and Ren-kun before you could actually endure them.”
“Fu, fu… you needn’t concern yourself with me.”

“If you want to invite Ren-kun along, maybe try saying something like, ‘I never… want to repeat that sorrow again. That’s why I’ll lend my power, and seize everyone’s tomorrow with the power of darkness.’ I bet he’d go along with that.”
“Is that so?”
Oh my. It seemed Ark was offering Black Thunder some genuine advice.

“That’s roughly the right direction. And, let’s see… you might get jealous seeing him hang around girls, but if you barge in there, he’ll just end up disliking you. Better to cheer him on from a distance and talk to him when he looks like he has free time, I think.”
“Getting distracted by romance is unbecoming of a Dark Holy Hero.”
“But you go around talking to every single girl in the village—isn’t it a bit selfish to say Ren-kun can’t do the same?”
“Ugh…”
Black Thunder was left utterly speechless, silenced completely by Ark.
“Even from where I stand, you two look close already. Get a little closer, and maybe he’ll ride you while shouting something like ‘Wings of Love, Black Thunder!’ or ‘Wings of Darkness, Gouraigou!’”
“…That might be nice.”
Black Thunder looked positively delighted. Was this really alright? I couldn’t claim to fully grasp the preferences of every Filolial-sama, but Black Thunder’s reaction still caught me off guard.

“As for Ren-kun, don’t you think he’ll grow into a rugged, handsome man as he gets older? Even more manly than now. Picture him mounted on your back against a backdrop of thunderclouds, a massive sword in one hand, roaring a battle cry as he cuts down the enemy… doesn’t that make quite the picture? Might as well get in his good graces now, don’t you think?”

For some reason, an image flashed through my mind—a gritty, manga-style Ren, transformed into a grizzled, battle-hardened swordsman, riding on Black Thunder’s back and swinging a massive blade to cut down foes. I had to admit, it would suit him rather well.
“Fufufu…”
Black Thunder chuckled, clearly not entirely displeased by the idea. Since Ark had arrived, I looked around for Ho-kun as well… but he wasn’t there. Perhaps he was still in the changing room?
“I’ll be getting in ahead of you. Is Ho-kun not here?”
“Ah, that bird went off somewhere else. Said he was going to take a bath in a volcano.”
“What, Ho-kun bathes in a volcano? Now that’s a Filolial-sama on a grand scale, I say.”

I vaguely recalled Rival and former-Rival mentioning something about bathing in volcanoes too, but I’d forgotten the details entirely. Still, I firmly believed Ho-kun’s bath was surely even more magnificent.
“Next time, allow me to lend what little assistance I can in washing Ho-kun’s back.”
“Sure, I’ll pass that along later.”
A few days later, Ho-kun made a point of firmly telling me, “You really don’t need to try washing my back!” for some reason.
“Well then, I suppose I’ll wash up too and make use of the bath myself.”

Ark began washing his body and hair right beside us in the bathhouse. He didn’t look particularly dirty to begin with. He had a tail like some furred lizard or dragon… now that I thought about it, his build really was quite peculiar. His lower half was that of a cat, after all.

Just as he started scrubbing his back with a towel, two reddish-black marks caught my eye. Now that I thought of it, Ho-kun had mentioned something earlier as if there were something on Ark’s back. Looking closely, wasn’t that exact spot where the Filolial-samas’ wings sprouted in their angelic forms? I’d taken him for some kind of cat beastman, but… could these possibly be scars from having his wings torn off? They looked as though something had been hacked clean away at the root. If this had happened to a Filolial-sama, I’d have made whoever did such a thing pay with their very life—that’s how horrific the wound looked to me.
“Hm?”
Perhaps noticing my stare, Ark turned to face me.
“Ah, this? Remember how that bird was blabbing on about it before? The story about something terrible happening to me while I was weakened—these are the scars from that.”
“That must have been a truly painful experience.”
I was now certain his wings had been torn off. Even for a god-slayer, that must have been an ordeal beyond words.
“Thanks for worrying about me, Motoyasu-kun.”
Watching Ark smile like that, I felt… somehow, a strange sense of déjà vu. For some reason, memories surfaced from back during the loops, from when I’d been in hiding on the way to Siltvelt.
“I’m not nearly as troubled by it as I might look, though. I can still fly just fine without wings.”
Ark drifted upward gently, as though lifting his body through sheer psychic power.
“And whenever I absolutely need them, I can just manifest wings through a different power. Like this.”

With a smooth motion, wings constructed of pure light emerged from Ark’s back. They were quite small, clearly held back deliberately, and while they resembled some winged variant of the wings that emerge when deploying Spear 0… they were actually the spitting image of the wings that had sprouted from the back of Father’s armor when he finished off the Crimson Swine’s true body.
“So really, there’s no need to worry so much.”
“I—I understand.”

It sounded to me as though he was saying he simply hadn’t bothered getting it treated since it wasn’t causing him any real trouble. And yet, for some reason, I couldn’t help but worry regardless. In any case, I supposed this must be the very thing Ho-kun had wanted me to find out about later? Though, would something this minor really warrant being so suggestively cryptic about it?
“Ho-kun had been so suggestively vague about the matter of Ark’s back.”
